description: tokenId = keccak256(abi.encode(appManifest, keccak256(bytes(version)))). Every language binding must reproduce these exactly.
source: Generated from verity-contracts LicenseToken.tokenIdFor and asserted against the deployed bytecode, not hand-computed. If a value here disagrees with the contract, the contract is right and this file is a bug.
why: TypeScript and Python must not drift from each other or from Solidity. A tokenId mismatch does not fail loudly — it produces a balanceOf lookup against an id nobody holds, so the app reports the holder as unauthorized and the real cause is three layers away.

vectors.note: Degenerate inputs are included on purpose: an implementation that special-cases empty strings or the zero address diverges here rather than in production.
